article.title: 首爾旅遊把K-pop宣傳片帶到海外七城戶外版位
article.title_en: Seoul extends its K-pop tourism film to outdoor placements in seven overseas cities
article.summary: 首爾市與首爾觀光財團公布戶外擴展安排，涵蓋紐約、東京、曼谷等市場。
article.summary_en: Seoul and its tourism organisation announced an outdoor expansion including New York, Tokyo and Bangkok.
highlights: 紐約時代廣場已播放活動精華，各城市按自身檔期安排。
highlights_en: The campaign features aespa’s Karina and Winter alongside RIIZE.
Times Square is showing highlights, with separate schedules by city.
article.why: 旅遊品牌可讓同一內容跨市場延伸，再按所在地的旅遊興趣及語言調整導流入口。
article.why_en: Tourism brands can extend one film across markets and localise the path to trip information.
article.next_step: 按投放城市設獨立的活動入口，分開記錄曝光、行程查詢及後續預訂。
article.next_step_en: Use distinct campaign entry points by city and track exposure, enquiries and bookings separately.
article.detail: 這次公布的是既有旅遊活動向海外戶外媒體延伸。紐約時代廣場和東京澀谷等版位的播放時間不同，其他城市亦按各自檔期安排。目的地團隊若參考做法，可保留辨識度高的主片，再按城市調整語言與旅遊資訊入口，並把戶外接觸後的查詢與最終預訂分開量度。各城市的導流成效宜分開比較。
article.detail_en: The announcement concerns an outdoor extension of an existing tourism campaign. Times Square and Shibuya have different runs, while other cities have their own schedules. Keep a recognisable master film and adapt language and trip information by city. Measure enquiries separately from bookings. Compare referral activity separately by city.
